Topic.label: Using Functions to Describe Real-World Patterns of Change

Question: A pool contains \(200\text{ m}^3\) of water and drains at \(20\text{ m}^3\) per hour. After draining for \(t\) hours, the remaining water volume is \(V=200-20t\). In this situation, what is the greatest value \(t\) can take?
Solution: The water volume cannot be negative, so \(200-20t\geq0\), giving \(t\leq10\). Thus, the greatest value of \(t\) is \(10\).

Original.prompt: 水池有水 200 m³，每小时放水 20 m³，放水 t 小时后剩水 V=200-20t。结合实际，t 最大能取多少？
Original.explanation: 水量不能为负，200-20t≥0，t≤10，所以 t 最大取 10。
